title: Attention and Perception in Learning
tagline: Understanding attention as a spotlight gateway and perception as active mental interpretation

key_terms.meaning: The selective gateway letting sensory information through for memory encoding.
Raw physical detection of sensory inputs by sensory organs like eyes.
Active mental organization and conscious interpretation of detected sensory inputs.
Failing to perceive visible objects because attention is occupied elsewhere.

properties.name: Captured, Not Commanded
properties.line: Novelty, contrast, meaning, and emotion pull focus rather than instructions.

properties.name: Divides Only at Price
properties.line: Splitting attention across multiple tasks reduces capacity and hinders understanding.

properties.name: Tires with Use
properties.line: Focus flags over time, especially in warm rooms or late periods.

teacher_moves.name: Move Hard Listening Early
teacher_moves.line: Schedule attention-heavy tasks during quiet periods before external noise increases.

teacher_moves.name: Separate Copying from Explaining
teacher_moves.line: Avoid requiring simultaneous writing and listening so pupils focus on understanding.

teacher_moves.name: Teach Perception Through Encounters
teacher_moves.line: Provide structured practice with named components until interpretation becomes automatic.

misconception.myth: Attention is a fixed trait that a pupil either possesses or lacks.
misconception.reality: Attention is a dynamic system governed by environment and task design.
